body: Trap: two worktrees of different commits sharing one CARGO_TARGET_DIR can make Cargo silently REUSE the other commit's binary. On 2026-11-22, C7 ran `cargo test --bin termal -- --list` on b090b35b and then on 4223aaa0 with the same target. Both checkouts had been created before the first build, so the candidate's source files had mtimes older than the build's dep-info. Cargo reported 'Finished in 0.17s' with no 'Compiling termal' line and the same termal-<hash>, so the candidate's list was the baseline's, which is invalid evidence (C7 #3641). Rule: any comparison or compile check across commits uses a SEPARATE, empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR per commit, or confirms that 'Compiling termal' appears in the log. Warm-target reuse is fine only for the SAME commit, or for a later commit whose checkout was created AFTER the previous build.
